description_en: Queries the basic permission diagnostic report of the current user for Spark
description_zh: 查看当前用户的Spark基本权限诊断报告
name: GetADBSparkNecessaryRAMPermissions

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看目标地域下所有集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

DeniedDetail.description_en: The diagnostic information returned when the permission check fails
DeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限检查失败时，返回权限检查失败相关的诊断信息

Action.description_en: The name of the RAM action for which authentication failed

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The type of access policy denial. Valid values:
ImplicitDeny: The resource owner has not configured a relevant access policy for the current user. Unauthorized operations are denied by default.
ExplicitDeny: The RAM policy configured by the resource owner explicitly denies the current user authorization to access the corresponding resource
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
权限策略拒绝的类型，取值如下：
ImplicitDeny：资源持有者未配置相关权限策略给当前用户，缺省拒绝未授权的操作。
ExplicitDeny：资源持有者配置的RAM策略明确拒绝了当前用户访问对应的资源

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the policy that caused the permission denial. Valid values:
ControlPolicy: control policy.
SessionPolicy: an additional permission policy attached to a temporary token.
AssumeRolePolicy: the trust policy of a RAM role.
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: an identity-access policy at the account authorization scope, including custom policies and system policies.
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: an identity-access policy at the resource group authorization scope, including custom policies and system policies
PolicyType.description_zh:
引起无权限的策略类型，取值如下:
ControlPolicy ：管控策略。
SessionPolicy：临时Token额外添加的一个权限策略。
AssumeRolePolicy：RAM角色的授信策略。
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：账号授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略。
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：资源组授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略

PrincipalType.description_en:
The identity type of the current user. Valid values:
SubUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
AssumedRoleUser: RAM role
PrincipalType.description_zh:
当前用户的身份类型，取值如下：
SubUser：RAM用户。
AssumedRoleUser：RAM角色

ResourceAuthTargetInfo.description_en: The information about the authentication target, which can be the Resource Access Management (RAM) users ID of the current user or the role information of the current accessor
ResourceAuthTargetInfo.description_zh: 鉴权对象的信息，可以是当前用户的RAM账号ID，或者当前访问者对应的角色信息

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the resource owner

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the current user has the basic permissions to use ADB Spark. Valid values:

true: The check is passed. The user has the basic permissions.
false: The check failed. The user is missing some permissions
Passed.description_zh:
检查是否具有使用ADB Spark的基本权限。

true：通过检查，持有基本权限。
false：检查失败，缺少部分权限

Suggestion.description_en: The recommended RAM configuration based on the diagnostic information
Suggestion.description_zh: 根据诊断信息，推荐客户在RAM系统中进行的配置
Suggestion.example: Grant the system RAM policy 'AliyunADBDeveloperAccess' to current RAM user can quickly solve this issue.
